title: Quadratic bandits with memory and an obliviously fixed loss sequence
summary: The current scalar quadratic loss depends on a window of recent actions, and the learner observes only its value on that window. The comparator uses the same fixed action throughout every window. The complete loss sequence is fixed before interaction.

task.formulation: The current scalar quadratic loss depends on a window of recent actions, and the learner observes only its value on that window. The comparator uses the same fixed action throughout every window. The complete loss sequence is fixed before interaction.

description_paragraphs: The current scalar quadratic loss depends on a window of recent actions, and the learner observes only its value on that window. The comparator uses the same fixed action throughout every window. The complete loss sequence is fixed before interaction.

model.instance: Each action is $x_t\in[0,1]$, with fixed initial history $x_{1-m:0}=0$. Memory length $m\ge2$ includes the current action; two previous actions plus the current action correspond to $m=3$. $$f_t:[0,1]^m\to\mathbb R\ \text{is convex quadratic},\qquad |f_t(z)|\le B,\qquad\|\nabla f_t(z)\|_2\le L\quad(\forall z\in[0,1]^m).$$ All $f_{1:T}$ are fixed before the learner's private randomness is generated; loss coefficients do not depend on realized past actions.
